zh-CN.homeEyebrow: 为复杂工作，组织一支 AI 团队
zh-CN.homeTitle:
让专业分工，
协作交付结果。
zh-CN.homeIntro: 从清晰目标开始，定义职责角色与交接方式；每项责任由配置的执行者承担，共同产出可检查的结果。
zh-CN.homeProof: 可运行团队示例 · 无需注册 · 中英文支持
zh-CN.visualTaskSub: 让团队朝同一个目标推进
zh-CN.visualResultSub: 职责 · 交接 · 下一步
zh-CN.visualFooter: 职责清晰，协作有序，过程可追踪
zh-CN.promiseOne: 每个职责都有清晰边界
zh-CN.promiseOneBody: 从目标拆解到结果整合，每项责任都在流程中明确。
zh-CN.promiseTwoBody: 随时了解谁在处理、信息如何流转。
zh-CN.promiseThreeBody: 回看各方意见、汇总过程和最终输出。
zh-CN.homeFooter: 为复杂工作构建协作团队
zh-CN.pageTitle: 把复杂任务，交给一支有分工的团队
zh-CN.pageIntro: 从一个目标开始。选择团队案例，了解成员之间如何协作，再运行一次完整流程。
zh-CN.metaValue: 完整团队流程 · 结果可回看
zh-CN.taskHint: 先选一个团队案例，也可以改写任务目标
zh-CN.taskPlaceholder: 例如：为一款记账工具制定首版研发方案
zh-CN.membersSubtitle: 成员各有专长，分工完成任务
zh-CN.flowSubtitle: 成员之间如何分工与衔接
zh-CN.splitNote: 职责角色按流程交接工作，并在汇总时整合所需信息。
zh-CN.capabilityKicker: 清楚 · 有序 · 可回看
zh-CN.capabilityTitle: 每一次协作，都有迹可循
zh-CN.capabilityBody: 团队按职责交接工作，运行过程保留时间线，成果可以逐步检查。
zh-CN.capabilityOneBody: 每个角色都有清晰的责任范围
zh-CN.capabilityTwoBody: 各方结果按团队安排汇总
zh-CN.capabilityThreeBody: 进度、结果和交接记录可查
zh-CN.footerNote: 公开体验展示完整的团队协作过程，不调用模型或生成业务交付内容。
zh-CN.libraryIntro: 选择已发布团队版本，开始管理项目任务。
zh-CN.historyIntro: 按任务查看团队运行结果。清理只影响本机缓存，不会删除项目记录。
zh-CN.noHistory: 还没有项目运行记录。完成一次项目任务后，这里会显示团队、版本和任务序号。
zh-CN.dryOutput: 本次预览展示团队如何分工与交接工作，不调用真实角色模型，也不会生成业务交付内容。
zh-CN.noOutput: 团队没有返回最终交付内容。
zh-CN.networkError: 暂时无法连接运行服务，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.promptCopied: 已载入案例任务，可继续修改。
zh-CN.readinessReady: 基础配置检查通过。外部服务连通性和凭据会在执行时验证。
zh-CN.readinessBlocked: 存在 {count} 个待处理项。请先修复配置；流程预览仍可使用。
zh-CN.readinessUnavailable: 暂时无法读取配置检查结果。开始隔离运行前会再次校验。
zh-CN.sandboxBlocked: 隔离运行 · 配置未就绪
zh-CN.factoryIntro: 在 OGS Studio 中编辑、调试并发布团队版本。
zh-CN.noReleasedTeams: 还没有已发布的团队版本
zh-CN.noFactoryTeams: OGS Studio 中还没有团队
zh-CN.confirmDeleteTeam: 确定删除团队“{name}”及其全部版本吗？此操作不可撤销。
zh-CN.confirmDeleteProject: 确定删除项目“{name}”及其任务、运行记录和资料吗？此操作不可撤销。
zh-CN.factoryEmptyHint: 用自然语言描述团队目标，再检查并发布版本。
zh-CN.targetHint: 请包含目标、角色关系、大致流程、输入材料和期望输出，便于自动生成团队结构。

en.homeIntro: Start with a clear goal. Define responsibility roles and handoffs; configured executors perform each responsibility and produce a reviewable outcome.
en.homeProof: Runnable team examples · No sign-up · Bilingual
en.visualTaskSub: One direction for the whole team
en.visualFooter: Clear roles. Coordinated work. Visible progress.
en.promiseOne: Every responsibility has a clear boundary
en.promiseOneBody: Each responsibility is explicit, from framing the task to assembling the result.
en.promiseTwoBody: See who is working and how information moves through the team.
en.promiseThreeBody: Revisit each view, the synthesis, and the final output.
en.pageTitle: Give complex work to a team with clear roles
en.pageIntro: Start with a goal. Choose a team, see how members work together, then run the complete example.
en.taskLabel: What would you like to accomplish?
en.taskHint: Choose a team example or rewrite the task
en.taskPlaceholder: For example: plan the first release of a bookkeeping tool
en.membersSubtitle: Each member brings a specialty to the shared task
en.flowSubtitle: How members divide and connect their work
en.splitNote: Responsibility roles hand off work through the flow and bring needed information together.
en.capabilityBody: Members hand off work by responsibility. A timeline captures progress, and you can review each result.
en.capabilityOneBody: Each role has a defined scope of responsibility
en.capabilityTwoBody: Results are assembled according to the team plan
en.capabilityThreeBody: Progress, results, and handoffs stay visible
en.footerNote: The public preview demonstrates a complete team workflow. It does not call models or generate business deliverables.
en.libraryIntro: Choose a released team version to start a project.
en.historyIntro: Review team runs by task. Clearing only affects this browser cache, not project records.
en.noHistory: No project runs yet. Complete a project task to see its team, version, and task number here.
en.dryOutput: This preview shows how the team divides and hands off work. It does not call role models or generate a business deliverable.
en.noOutput: The team returned no final delivery content.
en.networkError: The runtime is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
en.promptCopied: Example task loaded. You can edit it before running.
en.readinessReady: Basic configuration checks passed. Provider connectivity and credentials are checked during execution.
en.readinessBlocked: {count} items need attention. Flow preview remains available while you resolve them.
en.readinessUnavailable: Configuration check is unavailable. The server will validate again before an isolated run.
en.factoryIntro: Edit, debug, and release team versions in OGS Studio.
en.noFactoryTeams: No teams in OGS Studio yet
en.repositoryEmptyHint: Create and release a team first.
en.confirmDeleteTeam: Delete team “{name}” and all its versions? This cannot be undone.
en.confirmDeleteProject: Delete project “{name}” and its tasks, runs, and materials? This cannot be undone.
en.factoryEmptyHint: Describe a team goal, then review and release a version.
en.targetHint: Include the goal, role relationships, rough workflow, inputs, and expected outputs so the team structure can be generated accurately.
